questions.prompt: On Gemini 3.8 TTS, where does a delivery like "speaking slowly" for a whole turn go?

options.text: In the style field of its speech_metadata
options.explanation: Right. Google puts sustained delivery, such as pace and emotion, in speech_metadata.style.

options.text: In the text, in brackets before the line
options.explanation: Gemini 3.8 TTS treats the text as a verbatim transcript. Inline tags are for one moment, like a sigh or a pause.

options.text: In the voice name, as an added second word
options.explanation: The voice sets who speaks. Google puts turn-level delivery in the style field.

questions.prompt: Which OpenAI speech models ignore the instructions field?

options.explanation: The guide's own instructions examples use gpt-4o-mini-tts. The limit is on the other two models.
Right. OpenAI's API reference says instructions do not work with tts-1 or tts-1-hd.
OpenAI's API reference names two models where instructions do not work: tts-1 and tts-1-hd.

questions.prompt: ElevenLabs: you add "she said excitedly" to the text to set the mood. What happens to those words?

options.text: The model removes them before it speaks
options.explanation: ElevenLabs says descriptive text is spoken out by the model.

options.text: The model turns them into an audio tag
options.explanation: ElevenLabs does not say that. It says descriptive text is spoken and must be trimmed if unwanted.

options.text: They are spoken and must be cut out later
options.explanation: Right. ElevenLabs says descriptive text will be spoken out and must be trimmed or removed from the audio if unwanted.
